servinfo.title: Fail-Safe Table
servinfo.ptxt: When any of the following DTCs is detected, ECM control enters the fail-safe mode as long as the failure condition associated with the DTC continues. The fail-safe mode is canceled when ECM, ISG, DC/DC converter and auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) detects normal condition.
